TaskDescription: Single-session, two-class left- versus right-hand motor imagery in 55 novice BCI users. One calibration run (no feedback) plus three feedback runs of 40 trials each (20 left, 20 right). Study examined psychological and cognitive predictors of MI-BCI performance. Trial duration: 5.0s.
Instructions: Imagine moving the left or right hand following the cue.
InstitutionName: Tilburg University, Tilburg School of Humanities and Digital Sciences
Description: Single-session left/right-hand motor-imagery EEG from 55 novice BCI users (16 channels, 250 Hz, g.Nautilus), collected to study psychological and cognitive factors in motor-imagery BCI performance.
